entities.description: Will's sister who cracked a rift in a mountain.

events.summary: Imodane lost her arm to the Phyrexian invaders.
events.quote: she lost her arm to the invaders

events.summary: Imodane gathered rebels, declared herself Queen and demanded tribute.
Will fought Imodane in single combat; Rowan cracked a rift, sending Imodane fleeing into the Wilds.
events.quote: setting Imodane fleeing into the Wilds

events.summary: Talion tasked Imodane with defeating the witch sisters.
events.quote: who tasked her with defeating Agatha

events.summary: Agatha and Peter captured Imodane; Kellan killed Agatha and rescued her.
Imodane pledged fealty to Will and helped capture Eriette, ending the Wicked Slumber.
events.quote: helping to capture the witch Eriette and end the Wicked Slumber

relations.quote: pledging fealty to the boy king
